_effort_note: requested_effort is record-keeping ONLY; cli_suite.py never passes it to the child. The effective level comes from agent-default-model.config.reasoningEffort in the patch overlay.

_notes.surface: DSH headless one-shot conversation; not a subagent and not a Web subagent session
_notes.model: openrouter provider ('or'), nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free (multimodal: text+image; 1000000 ctx / 131072 max tokens)
_notes.model_id_note: the upstream model id contains '/' and ':' and is therefore not usable as a run-directory slug; runs live under F:/bench-runs/nvidia-nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free/
_notes.credential: OR_API_KEY resolves through the DSH credential seam; no secret is stored in this adapter
_notes.effort: reasoningEffort: max is pinned in the overlay and was confirmed on the wire by packet capture
_notes.thinking: compat.thinkingFormat=openrouter so reasoning is parsed in OpenRouter's shape
_notes.fresh_session: each invocation gets a new session-<uuid>; the adapter never passes --session-id
_notes.prompt: the two-line dispatch text is sent verbatim on stdin
_notes.cwd: cli_suite.py starts each process with cwd set to its external run workdir
_notes.no_delegation: subagent, workflow, skill, goal and ralph rows are disabled in the overlay
_notes.sandbox: shell, filesystem and web tools remain under the stock DSH sandbox policy; isolation stays unverified per protocol 2.0
_notes.proxy: the host requires egress via the Windows-registry proxy; Node needs NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 plus HTTP(S)_PROXY in the environment or API calls fail upstream
